gates.evidence: Unoccupied hooks, shoe cubbies, school pictures and terracotta cloakroom tiles meet the open doorway.
Same opening contains fruit trees in its upper depth and a cloud-filled pale-blue lower surface directly beyond the tile sill.
Brass weight rests on the indoor tiles beside the open door, both hands belong to the woman, but the weight is not visibly against the sill and load-bearing support of the leaf is ambiguous.
Dark short bob, fine parted fringe and face proportions resemble the supplied reference; no identity claim.
Late-afternoon warm light, familiar tactile school interior and calm impossible pastoral doorway coexist.
